title: Table column-name owner release

scope.rationale: The existing complete table column-array destructor is now canonically source-identified and used by table/view cleanup paths.

dependencies.caller_closure: Table and schema lifecycle owners call this complete column-array destructor.

outputs: Column names, column array, and ordinary-table defaults released
contracts.ownership: Consumes all column-name strings and the column array; default list is consumed for ordinary tables.
contracts.state_and_results: Normal mode clears pointers/count; bytes-freed accounting mode preserves inspected fields per source.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No I/O; caller owns schema synchronization.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Destructor allocates nothing and cannot fail.

representation_differences: Typed column slices and table-kind union replace C pointer arithmetic and IsOrdinaryTable macro.

oracle.protocol: Release null/populated view and ordinary-table columns in normal and bytes-freed modes.
oracle.normalization: Compare ownership and retained accounting fields.

assurance.malformed_input: Requires source-valid column count and pointers.
assurance.continuation: Normal caller must not reuse consumed columns.

integration.bounded_owner_retired: Existing complete implementation promoted to canonical source identity.

known_blockers: Focused allocator trace and evidence-state promotion.

upstream_tests: Project schema and broad runtime tests
